result.description: Tranzblast Coating Services  The Painter will be responsible for the application of paints, coatings and other finishes protecting and decorating a range of materials. This position requires self-discipline, motivation and attention to detail.                            Benefits  38 hr per week plus guaranteed minimum overtime plus superannuation.   Task & responsibilities  TASKS  -Masking of areas required for painting.  -Mixing two-part paints.  -Calculate and add thinners as required.  -Calculate layer thicknesses and drying times.  -Select paints/coatings based on features and requirements.  -Apply paints and coatings using brushes, rollers, and conventional or airless spray guns.  -Measure paint thickness using gauges.  -Carry out touch ups and repairs where required.  -Sanding surfaces and surface preparation.  -Erect and use ladders and platforms.  -Clean and maintain equipment.  -Metal Spraying applications.  -Able to apply zinc phosphates, inorganic zinc, epoxies, high build epoxies, polysiloxanes, polyurethanes, fluoropolymertopcoats and intumescent coatings to various surfaces using brushes, sprays and rollers  -Work from heights and in confined spaces  -Must be able to read plans and instructions  -Other duties, which may arise from time to time  RESPONSIBILITIES  -100% Work Health & Safety compliance   -Take measures to avoid contamination of other paints and materials, including segregating areas or blocking with barriers.  -Must have a focus on quality and accuracy  -Report non-conformances and assist in resolution  -Assist with in process inspection as needed  -Report any need for repairs and maintenance of workshop equipment.  -Comply with instructions from supervision  -Maintain proper time keeping practices  -Report any need for repairs and maintenance of workshop equipment.  -Ensure all tools are used are safe and are used in a safe manner.   Qualification & experience  - Must have 'Working at Heights' and 'Confined spaces'.  - Have or be able to obtain Elevating work platform (Boom, Scissor and Vertical lift(over 11m ) licences and experience.  - Minimum Cert III Painting pending experience  -Good verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively communicate with peers and reading skills is essential.  -The applicant must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude.  -The ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard of best work practices is a requirement.  Cert III or Cert IV plus experience.  Minimum 3 years Experience Painting  About Company    Tranzblast Coating Services (AUST) Pty Ltd is one of the largest and most respected paint and protective coatings applicators in Australia. The company delivers flexible service, offering a commitment to nurturing positive client relationships and an understanding of the rigorous demands in their clients' project work.  Tranzblast is backed by qualified personnel to NACE International Standards. Expression of Interest (EOI):    

  Cardiologists to provide Virtual Cardiac Care for Northern Territory: A Unique Opportunity    

   

 NT Cardiac is a private cardiac specialist practice which has been providing diagnostic and consultative services to both public and private patients over 25 years.  We have a well-established local infrastructure, diagnostic capability and IT infrastructure to enable Virtual cardiac care.  Given the increasing demand, we have successfully piloted remotely supported clinic and diagnostic reporting by cardiologists based in other states of Australia.  Based on this success, we are looking to expand this model of care to support patients from all over the Northern Territory including Aboriginal patients from remote communities. 

   

 NT Cardiac is seeking of Expression of Interest from Cardiologists interested in providing   Virtual Cardiac Care   to both private and public patients across the Northern Territory. This role allows cardiologists to work remotely from their current base locations, leveraging on digital health platforms to deliver high-quality, patient-centred cardiac care across the NT. 

   

 This model of care is ideal for cardiologists who are committed to improving access to specialist services in regional and remote Australia with a keen interest in Aboriginal heart health, and who are comfortable using virtual systems to deliver clinical care. 

   

  About the Role  

 
	 Patient-focused cardiac services, including imaging and diagnostic solutions. 
	 Access to state-of-the-art equipment and facilities. 
	 Supportive team including dedicated admin staff for local support and coordination, nurses, experienced diagnostic technicians, cardiac sonographers. 
	 NT resident cardiologists will provide support and assistance for patients needing urgent face to face consultations or investigations. 
	 Supported with secure access to the following digital platforms:
	 
		  Coviuu or TEAMS  for Telehealth Consultation 
		  Aura Portal  &  VIP.Net-  NT Cardiac’s Patient Management System for scheduling, referrals, and reporting. 
		  HeartLab  – for reviewing and reporting on echocardiograms. 
		  Epiphany  – for access and interpretation of ECGs, Holters, BPM results. 
		  Synapse access to  Radiology images 
	 
	 
	 Flexible or sessional arrangements working arrangements, including after hours. 
	 Competitive remuneration (negotiable) 
 

   

  Key Responsibilities  

 
	 Provide virtual consultation and diagnostic interpretation for referred patients. 
	 Refer, review and report on echocardiograms, ECGs, Holters and other investigations as required. 
	 Liaise with referring clinicians and NT Cardiac team to ensure continuity and quality of care.  
	 Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation via the Aura Portal / Practice Management System. 
 

   

  Requirements  

 
	 Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians (FRACP) in Cardiology or equivalent. 
	 Current specialist registration with AHPRA. 
	 Demonstrated experience in delivering high-quali    Apply Now
